# Cursor changelog — captured 2026-08-14
# https://cursor.com/changelog   (docs are at https://cursor.com/docs — sources.json still wrong)

### August 13, 2026 — "Cloud Agents start 3x faster with builds"   [NEW, held below the bar]
Introduces **builds**: pre-configured development environments that Cloud Agents boot into instead of
setting up from scratch each session. Environments boot 10x faster internally, 3x faster time to
first token. Failed builds never become active — agents keep using the last successful version. A new
**Builds tab** in the Cloud Agents dashboard allows inspection and debugging. Included at no cost.
[Watching tier: only MAJOR new capabilities qualify. A build is a cached environment snapshot and a
performance optimization, not a new agent capability or access surface. Recorded, not reported. If
Cursor Cloud Agents later become an inventory target, a build is a new artifact worth listing.]

### August 3, 2026 — Google Workspace Plugins   [reported 2026-08-07, unchanged]
Coding agents get read/write/act access to Gmail, Google Drive, Calendar, Docs and Sheets through
Google's remote MCP servers, installed from the Cursor Marketplace.

Prior, all previously covered: Jul 29 iPad support (PR review, inbox, Bitbucket + Azure DevOps SCM);
Jul 28 Cursor Start regional plan (India); Jul 22 Cursor Router; Jul 17 Slack integration.

Docs (cursor.com/docs) unchanged from the 2026-08-10 capture: Agent (incl. Plan Mode, design mode),
Customize (plugins, rules, skills, subagents, hooks, MCP), Cloud Agents (setup, builds, automations,
Bugbot, security agents, PR routing), Integrations, SDK & CLI, Teams & Enterprise.

Updated: 2026-08-14 — one new entry, held below the watching-tier bar.
**The `docs.cursor.com` -> `cursor.com/docs` 308 redirect remains unfixed in sources.json.**
